text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even with the Arima Kinen behind her, 
Narita Top Road still couldn't run the way 
she truly wanted to.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, she will never give up. With a 
smile, she says she will keep stubbornly 
fighting and struggling on harder than 
anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega also replied that she placed 
high expectations on Narita Top Road, 
which was why she wanted her to rise to 
them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Like stars shining brilliantly even in the 
midday sky— the era charted by the four 
stars will not end.
